title: Letter AI, whose sales software provides personalized, deal-specific guidance, raised a $40M Series B, four months after a $10.6M Series A (Geoff Weiss/Business Insider)
summary: Geoff Weiss / Business Insider: Letter AI, whose sales software provides personalized, deal-specific guidance, raised a $40M Series B, four months after a $10.6M Series A — - Letter AI has raised $40 million and is now valued in the hundreds of millions. — The sales software startup uses AI to deliver real-time, deal-specific guidance.
